correctness.rationale: On the smooth characteristic-two Hermitian cubic the degree-nine section factors into all 27 lines. Independent F4 enumeration verifies 45 points/45 ordinary triple intersections, 27 five-point lines, 7 fixed points/3 lines/9 branches, so connected boundary graph b1=64 and Frobenius H1 trace 0. The 27 exceptional classes span the geometric Picard rank 7; a rank-four orbit-sum minor of determinant 1 saturates the Frobenius invariants. This integral input plus finite-field Brauer vanishing/divisor exact sequence yields Pic(U)=0 and unit rank 11 (odd extension) or 20 (even); étale localization gives Hc^2 signs +1/-1 each 32, Hc^3 +2 x11/-2 x9, Hc^4 4, and all-extension Q(Q-2)/(Q-4)(Q-16) counts. Standard localization/cohomological vanishing is used as an algebraic theorem, not inferred from finite data.
